How it works · 4 steps

Booked in 3 minutes.
Gone in a day.

No phone tag. No in-home estimates. No on-site upcharges. Online from start to finish — for a category that used to require three phone calls and a Saturday-afternoon visit from a salesman.

01 ~ 60 seconds

Get your price online.

Enter your ZIP code and pick the items you're getting rid of. Your guaranteed price displays immediately — no callback, no in-home estimate, no waiting for an email back. Pricing depends on your exact ZIP, item type, and floor access, and it's the final number.

  • Couches, sectionals, sleepers, recliners — all priced separately
  • Stairs and walk-ups included when noted at booking — no per-flight surcharges
  • Add multiple items to one pickup at a bundled rate
02 ~ 30 seconds

Pick a pickup window.

Same-day pickup is available in most cities when you book before 2PM EST. Next-day pickup is the default everywhere we operate. Choose a 4-hour window that works for your schedule — early morning, midday, afternoon, or evening.

  • Confirmation email and SMS sent immediately
  • Track your assigned Loader's progress on pickup day
  • Reschedule free up to 2 hours before your window
03 ~ 90 seconds

Pay upfront online.

Card charged at booking. No in-person charges, no surprise on-site upcharges for the scope you book, no surprise fees at the door. The price you saw online is the price you pay — and that's the only price you pay, regardless of how heavy the couch is or how many flights of stairs we have to navigate.

  • All major credit cards accepted
  • Payment receipt emailed immediately after booking
  • Full refund if we can't make the pickup
04 ~ 15-20 min on site

A Loader handles it.

An independent local Loader arrives in your scheduled window. They remove the couch from any room in your home — bedrooms, basements, walk-up apartments, narrow stairwells, alley access. Then they route the item through local partners for donation, recycling, or compliant disposal based on its condition.

  • Background-checked, insured Loaders — typically 200+ jobs of experience
  • Disassembly tools included for sectionals and oversized pieces
  • Donation-first routing whenever the item qualifies
What happens after pickup

The path depends on condition.

Every couch is evaluated at pickup and routed to the place that makes sense for its condition. Donation-first when the item qualifies; recycling when it doesn't; compliant disposal only when nothing else works.

DONATABLE

Donation pickup

Clean upholstery, intact frame, no major stains or pet damage, all original pieces. Donatable items are routed to local 501(c)(3) charity partners.

of couches donated
  • Habitat for Humanity ReStore
  • Salvation Army & Goodwill chapters
  • Furniture Bank Network affiliates
  • Local secular & faith-based partners
WORN OR BROKEN

Material recovery

Visible wear, broken frame, torn upholstery. Wood, steel springs, and metal connectors are sent to scrap-metal and material-recovery facilities.

of couches recycled
  • Wood frames chipped or repurposed
  • Steel springs & connectors → scrap metal
  • Foam & fabric to material-recovery facilities
UNSALVAGEABLE

Compliant disposal

Smoke damage, biohazards, severe contamination, bedbug exposure. Routed to compliant waste-management facilities per local regulations.

may go to disposal
  • Routed to licensed, compliant facilities
  • Compliant with state waste codes
  • Hazardous-material handling when needed
Why the platform model works

Two-sided marketplace, one customer experience.

The platform handles the things software is good at — booking, scheduling, payment, dispatch, customer support. Independent local Loaders handle the things humans are good at — lifting, driving, navigating stairs, knowing the local donation partners.

Online from start to finish

Pricing, booking, scheduling, payment — all online. No phone tag, no salespeople, no in-home estimates that turn into 90-minute visits. The whole transaction is shorter than the time it takes to drag a couch to the curb.

Upfront pricing, no upcharges

The price you see at booking is the price you pay. No "the truck was full" charges, no "extra-flight" fees, no "tipped the worker" pressure. Stairs, disassembly, distance, recycling fees — all included in the quote.

Donation routing built in

Donatable items go to local charity partners — Habitat ReStore, Salvation Army, Furniture Bank affiliates — by default. The Loader knows the local partners and their schedules; the customer doesn't have to coordinate anything.

Background-checked Loaders

Every Loader is screened, insured, and rated by past customers. Most have completed 200+ jobs through the platform before they reach your door. Customer reviews follow them and influence which jobs they're offered.

Three minutes to book. One day to done.

Pick your item, enter your ZIP, and a Loader handles the rest.
